basis: Pilgrim’s Pride first established the decline in its fiscal Q2 2023 results release. The consolidated income statement reports net sales of $4,308,091,000 for the three months ended June 25, 2023, versus $4,631,648,000 for the three months ended June 26, 2022. Sales fell 6.986% year over year, below the $4,400,065,600 cutoff. Both figures come from the same GAAP net-sales row. The earlier disclosures reviewed contained no numeric upper bound for Q2 consolidated sales.

coverage.detail: February 8, preceding earnings cycle. Pilgrim’s reported $4.1 billion of Q4 2022 sales and $17.5 billion for fiscal 2022. It gave no Q2 2023 consolidated sales range.
The Q4 2022 presentation covered historical financial results, poultry production and commodity prices. Its market indicators supplied no upper bound for company-wide Q2 2023 revenue.
February 9 call. Management discussed USDA’s 1.1% industry production growth forecast for 2023 and possible second-half production declines. Neither quantified Pilgrim’s Q2 consolidated sales.

April 26, immediately preceding release. The reported 1.8% sales decline applied to Q1 ended March 26. Management discussed input costs, commodity prices and margins without giving a Q2 consolidated sales forecast.
The Q1 investor presentation covered fiscal 2023 capital spending, poultry placements, cold storage and per-pound prices. It contained no Q2 consolidated revenue target.

April 27 call. In response to a question about summer profitability, management discussed supply and demand by bird size and volatility in the U.S. commodity business. It gave no numeric Q2 company-wide sales ceiling.

The intervening May 2 Form 8-K reported voting results from the April 26 annual meeting. Searches for preliminary results, updated guidance, investor presentations and public management remarks through July 25 identified no qualifying Q2 sales disclosure.
July 11 was a scheduling announcement. Pilgrim’s said it would release results after the U.S. market close on July 26 and hold the call July 27. The notice gave no preliminary sales figure.
The earnings release furnished as Exhibit 99.1 carries the July 26 dateline. Its consolidated quarterly net-sales row gives 4,308,091 and 4,631,648 in thousands of dollars.
The original wire distribution identifies Pilgrim’s Pride Corporation as the source and timestamps publication at 17:00 ET on July 26, 2023.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer’s IR page and Exhibit 99.1 both date the results release July 26, 2023. The issuer-sourced wire timestamp confirms public distribution that day at 17:00 ET, before the July 27 earnings call and Form 10-Q filing.
